items.raw_excerpt: Kollam Corporation's 10-day 'Onaravam' Onam celebrations begin August 20, featuring cultural performances, parades, and live music.
items.summary_en: Kollam Corporation is starting a 10-day festival called Onaravam on August 20. The event will feature cultural performances, parades, and live music. It celebrates the traditional Onam festival in Kerala, India.
items.summary_ko: 콜람시는 8월 20일부터 10일간 전통 축제인 '오나라밤'을 개최합니다. 문화 공연, 퍼레이드, 라이브 음악 등 다양한 행사가 준비되어 있습니다. 이번 축제는 인도 케랄라주의 전통 명절인 오남을 기념하기 위해 열립니다.
items.title_en: Kollam Corporation to kick off 10-Day Onaravam celebrations on August 20
items.title_ko: 콜람시, 20일부터 10일간 '오나라밤' 축제 시작
items.title_original: Kollam Corporation to kick off 10-Day ‘Onaravam’ celebrations on August 20

items.raw_excerpt: Pizza Express apologises to Halesworth family who were not allowed in to the South Mimms restaurant.
items.summary_en: A family from Halesworth was refused entry to a Pizza Express restaurant in South Mimms. The restaurant said the boy's safe foods could not be accommodated. Pizza Express has since apologised to the family.
items.summary_ko: 헤일스워스의 한 가족이 사우스 밈스의 피자 익스프레스 매장에 입장하지 못했다. 아이가 먹을 수 있는 음식이 제한되어 있다며 매장 측이 거절했기 때문이다. 이후 피자 익스프레스는 이 가족에게 공식 사과했다.
items.title_en: Family refused Pizza Express entry over boy's safe foods
items.title_ko: 피자 익스프레스, 아이 '안전 음식' 이유로 가족 입장 거절
items.title_original: Family refused Pizza Express entry over boy's 'safe foods'

items.raw_excerpt: Taipei will introduce Taiwan's first postpartum meal allowance program in 2027, providing NT$30,000 (US$940) per delivery and benefiting about 11,000 mothers each year, the city government announced Wednesday.
items.summary_en: Taipei will launch Taiwan's first postpartum meal allowance program in 2027. The program will pay NT$30,000 (US$940) to each mother after delivery. About 11,000 mothers will benefit from the program each year.
items.summary_ko: 타이베이시가 2027년부터 대만 최초의 산후 식사 수당 제도를 시행합니다. 출산 한 번당 3만 대만 달러(약 940달러)가 지급되며, 매년 약 1만1천 명의 산모가 혜택을 받게 됩니다.
items.title_en: Taipei to introduce Taiwan's first postpartum meal allowance
items.title_ko: 대만 최초의 산후 식사 수당, 타이베이에서 2027년부터 도입
items.title_original: Taipei to introduce Taiwan's first postpartum meal allowance

items.raw_excerpt: There's still some way to go to reach pre-pandemic levels, according to an expert from Statistics Finland.
items.summary_en: Finnish airports saw their highest passenger numbers in July in several years. However, traffic has not yet returned to pre-pandemic levels, according to Statistics Finland.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드 공항의 7월 여객량이 수년 만에 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다. 그러나 핀란드 통계청에 따르면 여전히 코로나19 이전 수준에는 미치지 못하고 있다.
items.title_en: Finnish airports had their busiest July in years
items.title_ko: 핀란드 공항, 올해 7월 여객량 수년 만에 최고치
items.title_original: Finnish airports in July were busiest in years

items.raw_excerpt: LONDON, Aug 19 : Sheffield United's former owner on Wednesday won a bid to wind up the company that in 2024 bought the second-tier Championship side, which said the High Court's decision was not an issue for the club.United World, led by Prince Abdullah bin Mosaad bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, filed a winding-up pet
items.summary_en: The former owner of Sheffield United has won a High Court bid to wind up the company that purchased the second-tier football club in 2024. The club stated that the court's decision does not pose an issue for their operations.
items.summary_ko: 셰필드 유나이티드의 전 소유주가 2024년 해당 구단을 인수한 회사를 청산하기 위한 고등법원 소송에서 승소했습니다. 구단 측은 법원의 이번 결정이 구단 운영에는 문제가 되지 않는다고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: Sheffield United's ex-owner wins bid to wind up company that bought club

items.title_original: Sheffield United's ex-owners winds up company which bought club

items.raw_excerpt: Rain is expected across Taiwan from Thursday through the weekend under the influence of a low-pressure system, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Wednesday.
items.summary_en: A low-pressure system will bring rain to Taiwan from Thursday through the weekend. The Central Weather Administration announced the forecast on Wednesday. A tropical storm has also formed in the region.
items.summary_ko: 저기압 영향으로 목요일부터 주말까지 대만 전역에 비가 내릴 전망이다. 기상청은 수요일 이 예보를 발표했다. 해당 지역에서 열대성 폭풍도 발생했다.
items.title_en: Rain expected across Taiwan through weekend; tropical storm forms

items.raw_excerpt: What do you call a mouse-like creature with wings? Why, a "flappy-mouse," of course.
items.summary_en: The Swedish word fladdermus means flutter-mouse. It is the word for bat, the flying mammal that looks like a mouse with wings.

items.raw_excerpt: Festival organisers in Portugal have until 30 September to apply for the Accessible Festivals Programme, which recognises events that make culture more accessible to everyone.
items.summary_en: Festival organisers in Portugal have until 30 September to apply for the Accessible Festivals Programme. The programme recognises events that make culture more accessible to everyone.

items.raw_excerpt: The winners of a lottery for taxpayers, including foreign nationals, who filed their 2025 individual income tax returns using a mobile device will be announced at 4 p.m. Friday, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said Wednesday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance will announce lottery winners on Friday. The lottery is for taxpayers who filed their 2025 income tax returns using a mobile device. Foreign nationals who filed on mobile are also eligible.
items.summary_ko: 대만 재정부가 금요일 모바일로 2025년 소득세를 신고한 납세자 대상 복권 당첨자를 발표한다. 외국인 납세자도 모바일 신고 시 당첨 대상에 포함된다.
items.title_en: Taiwan to announce mobile tax filing lottery winners Friday

items.raw_excerpt: Other projects to get help under MSF's PATH fund include one that helps rough sleepers get apprenticeships and another that will upgrade a temporary shelter's facilities.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Ministry of Social and Family Development is funding new pilot projects to help rough sleepers. One initiative helps homeless people find co-tenants for rental flats, while another provides apprenticeships. A third project will upgrade temporary shelter facilities.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 가족개발부가 노숙자를 돕기 위한 시범 프로젝트에 자금을 지원하고 있습니다. 한 사업은 노숙자가 임대 아파트의 룸메이트를 찾을 수 있도록 돕고, 다른 사업은 직업 훈련 기회를 제공합니다. 또 다른 프로젝트는 임시 숙소 시설을 개선할 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Singapore funds pilot projects to help rough sleepers find flatmates
items.title_ko: 싱가포르, 노숙자가 룸메이트를 찾을 수 있는 시범 프로젝트에 자금 지원
items.title_original: Initiative to help rough sleepers find co-tenants for rental flats among pilot projects given MSF funding

items.raw_excerpt: It could be a wet and windy day out for Shaun the Sheep as the Met Office looks to name its storms.
items.summary_en: The UK Met Office is considering naming a future storm after Shaun the Sheep, the beloved claymation character. Weather naming is a tradition where storms are given human or character names for easier public communication.
items.summary_ko: 영국 기상청이 새로운 폭풍 이름을 숀 더 셰프로 지정하는 것을 검토하고 있습니다. 숀 더 셰프는 영국의 인기 있는 클레이메이션 캐릭터입니다. 날씨 Naming에 유명인이나 캐릭터 이름을 사용하는 것은 영국의 전통입니다.
items.title_en: Met Office could name storm after Shaun the Sheep
items.title_ko: 기상청, 숀 더 셰프 이름으로 폭풍 이름 지정 검토
items.title_original: Met Office could name storm after Shaun the Sheep

items.raw_excerpt: Radzambo Secondary School in Matsila village is crumbling, overcrowded and short of teachers
items.summary_en: A rural school in Limpopo, South Africa is crumbling and overcrowded. Parents say classrooms are unsafe and the school lacks enough teachers.

items.raw_excerpt: An MP from the Left Party has submitted a written question to Migration Minister Johan Forssell asking what he is doing to prevent the deportation of elderly, vulnerable British citizens as a result of the UK's decision to leave the EU.
items.summary_en: A Left Party MP in Sweden has sent a written question to Migration Minister Johan Forssell. The MP asks what the government is doing to stop the deportation of elderly, vulnerable British citizens following the UK's exit from the EU.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 좌파당 소속 의원이 이민 장관에게 영국의 EU 탈퇴 이후 고령·취약 영국 시민의 추방을 막기 위한 정부 조치를 묻는 서면 질문서를 제출했다. EU 탈퇴로 인해 체류 자격이 불확실해진 영국 시민들의 상황을 우려하는 내용이다.

items.title_ko: 스웨덴 좌파당 의원, 브렉시트 이후 고령 영국인 추방 문제에 장관 질문
items.title_original: Swedish MP pressures migration minister on deportation of elderly Brits

items.raw_excerpt: From school bags and sports kit to transport and class trips, the costs add up fast. Here's what parents in Germany need to know about keeping expenses under control and claiming support.
items.summary_en: Families in Germany face rising costs for school supplies, transport, and class trips. The government offers financial support to help parents manage these expenses. Here is what families need to know about claiming this help.

items.raw_excerpt: Sticks and stones (probably) won't break your bones in today's expression of the day.
items.summary_en: The Local Denmark shares a Danish expression meaning going over sticks and stones. The phrase describes a rough or bumpy journey. It is part of a series explaining everyday Danish sayings.

items.raw_excerpt: Sometimes you find an official-looking piece of paper affixed to your mailbox or front door, or a mail delivery person bringing you something to sign. But should you?
items.summary_en: Swiss residents may receive official-looking documents at their home by mail or in person. These can include summons that legally require a signature. Learn which ones are legitimate and what you should do.

items.title_en: What official papers can you receive at your Swiss home?

items.raw_excerpt: If you are moving to Austria, can you keep using your home country's bank account or open an international one online, or should you really have an Austrian one?
items.summary_en: Are you moving to Austria and wondering if you need a local bank account? This guide explores whether you can keep using your home country's account or if an Austrian one is necessary.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아로 이주할 때 기존 해외 계좌를 계속 사용할 수 있는지, 혹은 꼭 현지 계좌를 만들어야 하는지 알아봅니다. 국제 계좌와 현지 계좌의 장단점을 비교하여 실용적인 조언을 제공합니다.
items.title_en: Reader question: Do I need to open a local bank account when moving to Austria?

items.title_original: Reader question: Do I need to open a local bank account when moving to Austria?

items.raw_excerpt: The number of dentists trained outside the EU who are moving to the Netherlands to help fill a chronic national shortage has more than doubled in five years, with recent arrivals coming from countries including Syria, South Africa, Turkey, Brazil and Iraq. One in four dentists now working in the country qualified abroad, according to the dentists’ association KNMT, and in Zeeland more than half were trained overseas. Figures from the Amsterdam dental school ACTA, which runs the admissions proces
items.summary_en: The number of dentists trained outside the EU who move to the Netherlands to fill a national shortage has more than doubled in five years. Recent arrivals come from Syria, South Africa, Turkey, Brazil, and Iraq. One in four dentists in the country now qualified abroad.
items.summary_ko: EU 외 국가에서 훈련받은 치과의사가 네덜란드로 이주하는 수가 5년 만에 두 배 이상 늘었다. 시리아, 남아프리카공화국, 터키, 브라질, 이라크 등에서 온 신규 입국자가 포함된다. 현재 네덜란드 치과의사 4명 중 1명은 외국에서 훈련을 받았다.
items.title_en: Number of non-EU dentists in Netherlands doubles in five years

items.raw_excerpt: The Normandy beach town of Trouville-sur-Mer is a two-hour train ride from Paris, but feels a world away, with English Channel breezes and the sound of seagulls screeching through the cobbled streets.
items.summary_en: Trouville-sur-Mer is a quiet beach town in Normandy, France. It sits just two hours from Paris by train. The town has barely changed since Claude Monet painted its shores.

items.title_en: A Normandy beach town that looks just like Monet's paintings

items.title_original: Greetings from Trouville-sur-Mer, a beach town little changed since Monet painted it

items.raw_excerpt: Many Finnish Russians would like to give up their Russian citizenship, but a new law has made the process ten times more expensive.
items.summary_en: Many Finnish Russians want to renounce their Russian citizenship. A new law has made the process ten times more expensive. The price hike makes it much harder for people to give up their ties to Russia.

items.title_en: Giving up Russian citizenship now costs ten times more
